claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantResistanceOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Stoneskin grants Resistance to three damage types (Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing) as an ongoing concentration effect. OngoingOperation currently only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit variants. A grant_resistance variant is needed. The v4 atom grant_resistance already exists (Section 9 Effect Atoms), so no new atom is required — only a new surface variant of OngoingOperation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
